document: Alone Against The Frost Solitaire Adventure in Canadas Wilds (Glenn Rahman  Gavin Inglis) (z-library.sk, 1lib.sk, z-lib.sk).pdf

paragraphs.text:
You run, propelled by mortal terror, until your strength gives 
out. You collapse against a tree, gulping air. But the bloodletting 
is over. Perhaps the invisible killer is somehow tied to the stone 
formation where you encountered it. However, you have run 
deep into the woods and cannot find your way back to camp.

If all of your students survived, go to 158. If you lost one, go to 324. 
If you lost two, go to 279. If they are all dead, go to 67.
